title: Trucking company, new business in an existing leased industrial yard, no construction — Juncos, zone X
description: We are starting a local trucking company in Juncos with four box trucks, operating from an existing leased yard and office in an industrial area. We haul goods for other businesses on the island. No construction.

mustInclude.rationale: RULE_0002 municipality baseline: every business gets the IRS EIN; employees also trigger RULE_0620.
RULE_0003 municipality baseline: Registro de Comerciante (SURI).
RULE_0651: new LLC -> Certificate of Organization (Departamento de Estado).
RULE_0004 municipality baseline: Patente Municipal (Ley 107-2020 Codigo Municipal).
RULE_0007: physical commercial premises -> Permiso Unico (Ley 161-2009).
RULE_0177: BT_TRUCKING_COMPANY -> Negociado de Transporte y otros Servicios Públicos carrier authorization.
RULE_0178: BT_TRUCKING_COMPANY -> commercial vehicle registration (CESCO / DTOP).

mustNotInclude.rationale: No construction stated: RULE_0643/0644 need a construction / renovation project type.
FEMA zone X: RULE_0706/0707 need location.flood_zone.sfha / floodway, which zone X never sets.
Pin outside the official coastal zone: RULE_0708 needs location.czm.
No alcohol: RULE_0013/0014 need Q_ALCOHOL_SOLD / Q_ALCOHOL_SERVED; business-type alcohol rules exist only for Bar / Juice Bar.

ordering.rationale: KB documents.json: DOC_PATENTE_MUNICIPAL depends on DOC_PERMISO_UNICO.

notes: Added 2026-10-13 by the scenario loop: first trucking scenario and first Juncos scenario. Port / TSA rules (RULE_0578, RULE_0592) are not asserted either way.
